description: Elections Commission - Order under Section 03 of the Regulation of Election Expenditure Act, No. 03 of 2023 (This Gazette has been rearranged due to the order of the published without any change in Content)
categorisation: This gazette notification specifically regulates election expenditure for the Local Authorities Election - 2023, including authorized spending limits for candidates and political parties, reporting requirements for campaign finances, and restrictions on donations. It is issued by the Election Commission under the Regulation of Election Expenditure Act and deals exclusively with electoral processes, making it a clear example of an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
